members.name: open
members.description: HoverCard wraps PreviewCard. Its content is a plain div, not a fabricated dialog or tooltip role; full information remains available at the link destination. Content defaults side=bottom, sideOffset=4, align=center, alignOffset=4. The reference lab explicitly sets delay/closeDelay to 0 to exercise the same source interaction promptly.
